ai.title: Backend 1.0.51 fixes file response accumulation
ai.summary: Bumped backend package.json version to 1.0.51. Moved fullResponse += fileContent after fileProcessingPromises.push() in backend/src/main-prompt.ts. Scope: backend package only. Prevents race condition where file content was appended before async processing queued.

eli5.text: When the assistant handles a file you send it, it now waits to collect the file's content until after the system has queued up the behind-the-scenes work to process that file, instead of grabbing the content too early. This prevents a timing issue where parts of your file could have been missed or mishandled while the system was still getting ready. It's the kind of thing you'd only notice if files you sent in were occasionally incomplete; now that should stop happening. The fix is live now.

ai.title: Add conversation context to diff generation prompts
ai.summary: Conversation history and full assistant response are injected into prompts in generate-diffs-prompt.ts and generate-diffs-via-expansion.ts. This ensures the model considers user intent, preventing deletion of unshown code when expanding files or generating search/replace blocks. Internal backend change affecting diff accuracy.

eli5.text: When the assistant writes or edits code for you, it can now see the full back-and-forth of your conversation and its own earlier response while deciding what to keep or change. This means fewer cases where it accidentally deletes parts of your file that were never shown to it. The improvement is live today in the backend that generates code suggestions.
